nurse.text: Welcome to the Aberystwyth Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter. Mind the starling feathers.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Cwtch them in for a minute, we'll have them right as rain.
All better! Don't be a stranger, and do wipe your feet. The sea comes in everywhere.
The Ark terminal's just here. It's been fine since the student unplugged it to charge a phone.

else.text: Right you are. Shout if anyone needs a plaster.
